units.source_text: 源氏想起：必须先替玉鬘举行着裳仪式。

en.t: Genji remembered that he first had to hold the coming-of-age robe ceremony for Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 便逐步置办种种精美的用品。

en.t: He therefore began gradually preparing all sorts of elegant supplies.

units.source_text: 凡举行仪式，即使主人不想铺张，

en.t: Whenever a ceremony is held, even if the host does not intend to make it extravagant,

units.source_text: 也自然会办得隆重堂皇。

en.t: it naturally turns out solemn and splendid.

units.source_text: 何况此次打算趁此机会向内大臣揭穿实情。

en.t: All the more so this time, since he intended to use the occasion to reveal the truth to the Inner Minister.

units.source_text: 因此置备各种物品，异常精美丰富。

en.t: For that reason, the many items prepared were exceptionally fine and abundant.

units.source_text: 着裳仪式的日期，预定在明年二月内。

en.t: The date for the robe ceremony was set for sometime in the second month of the following year.
